==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Known for his {{ci|Pyke}} due to a famous [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q3UiIqHJxoI Dong Huap video] detailing the pick.
* After winning Worlds in 2020, spent around $7000 on the game ''[[wikipedia:en:Genshin Impact|Genshin Impact]]''.<ref>[https://www.oneesports.gg/lol/damwons-beryl-blew-nearly-us7k-on-genshin-impact-loot-boxes-after-winning-worlds/] ''oneesports.gg''</ref>
* Asked Riot to design his Worlds 2020 Leona skin after his "wife", Saren Sasaki from ''[[wikipedia:en:Princess Connect! Re:Dive|Princess Connect! Re:Dive]]''.<ref>[https://twitter.com/AshleyKang/status/1326873279030652928 Ashley Kang's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* Often watches [[G2 Esports]] and takes inspiration from them.

=== Statistics ===
* The fourth player to have 3 consecutive appearances in Worlds Final, after [[Faker]], [[Bang]], and [[Wolf (Lee Jae-wan)|Wolf]].
* The second player after [[Duke (Lee Ho-seong)|Duke]] to win two Worlds titles in different teams, and the first and only one to do so without playing for [[SK Telecom T1]].
* Known for knocking out [[Keria]] in Worlds in 3 consecutive years (2020-2022), in 3 different stages of brackets (quarterfinal, semifinal, final, respectively).
* The first player to lift both versions of Summoner's Cup.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LCK on June 29, 2023.
** Was the 12th player to reach 3000 assists in the LCK after [[GorillA]], [[Wolf (Lee Jae-wan) | Wolf]], [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[TusiN]], [[Deft]], [[Peanut]], [[Lehends]], [[Bdd]], [[Keria]], and [[Life]].
* Reached 4000 assists in the LCK on August 14, 2024.
** Was the 8th player to reach 4000 assists in the LCK after GorillA, Faker, Lehends, Peanut, Keria, Deft, and Bdd
* Reached 5000 assists in the LCK on September 17, 2025
** Was the 5th player to reach 5000 assists in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[Lehends]], [[Peanut]], and Keria.
* Reached 500 games in the LCK on July 21, 2024, becoming the 17th player to do so.
* Reached 600 games in the LCK on August 30, 2025, becoming the 16th player to do so.
* Reached 300 wins in [[LCK]] on April 09, 2025, becoming the 18th player to do so.
{{PlayerStatsTrivia}}

=== Individual Awards ===
* LCK 1st All-Pro Team x1 (Summer 2020)
* LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x2 (Spring 2021, Spring 2022)
